component.name: WebPlus
component.summary: Design and publish websites by dragging things onto a page

description.p: WebPlus is a website designer. Drag text, pictures, buttons, forms, shapes and more onto a page, link the pages together, and publish a clean site that fits any screen from a phone to a wide monitor. The finished site is plain files you put on your own web host. There is no account and no subscription.

It includes a pen tool and shape editor, PhotoLab and picture effects, Database Merge, a blog with comments, web polls, a shop with PayPal, Stripe, Shopify and WooCommerce, PDF export, and an FTP publisher.
Blog, web polls and a shop; pen tool, shapes, crop to shape and PhotoLab; Database Merge; PDF export with clickable links.
